# Calderwood Data Services -- Master Service Agreement

This Master Service Agreement records the terms on which Calderwood Data Services provides data engineering and managed data platform services to Halvard Systems. It is synthetic material generated for NorthForge evaluation; Calderwood Data Services, Halvard Systems, and every person named below are fictional.

## Term and Renewal

The initial term of this Master Service Agreement begins on 2026-04-12 and ends on 2027-04-12. The term then renews automatically for successive twelve (12) month terms unless Halvard Systems or Calderwood Data Services delivers written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term.

## Termination

Termination for convenience is available to Halvard Systems on one hundred twenty (120) days notice. Calderwood Data Services may terminate for cause only where Halvard Systems fails to pay undisputed fees and does not cure within thirty (30) days of written notice.

## Limitation of Liability

The aggregate liability of Calderwood Data Services to Halvard Systems under this Master Service Agreement shall not exceed USD 750,000 across all claims, and indirect or consequential loss is excluded entirely. This cap does not apply to breaches of confidentiality, to data protection breaches, or to unpaid fees, for which liability remains uncapped.

## Governing Law

Governing law and venue. The law of the Republic of Ireland applies to this Master Service Agreement. Calderwood Data Services and Halvard Systems agree that the courts of the Republic of Ireland have exclusive jurisdiction over disputes arising from it.

## Data Protection

Personal data processed by Calderwood Data Services on behalf of Halvard Systems is governed by the Data Protection Addendum incorporated into this Master Service Agreement. Calderwood Data Services shall keep Customer Data encrypted in transit and at rest and shall give Halvard Systems forty-five (45) days notice of any new subprocessor.

## Payment Terms

Calderwood Data Services invoices Halvard Systems monthly in arrears. Undisputed invoices are payable within fifteen (15) days of receipt, and late undisputed amounts accrue interest at one and a half percent (1.5%) per month.

## Confidentiality

Confidential Information disclosed under this Master Service Agreement remains the property of the disclosing party. Calderwood Data Services shall return or destroy the Confidential Information of Halvard Systems on request, and confidentiality obligations survive two (2) years beyond termination.

## Notices

Contractual notices are delivered electronically: Halvard Systems receives notices at contracts@halvard.example.com and Calderwood Data Services at contracts@calderwood.example.com. A notice is deemed received on the next business day after transmission.

## Service Levels

Calderwood Data Services shall meet a monthly availability target of 99.9 percent, measured over each calendar month, with service credits as the sole remedy for a missed target.

## Support and Escalation

Support requests are triaged into four priorities. Calderwood Data Services shall respond to a priority-one request within one hour and escalate to a named duty manager if it is unresolved after four hours.

## Change Control

No change to scope, fees, or service levels takes effect until Halvard Systems and Calderwood Data Services sign a change request that identifies the affected deliverables.

## Acceptance Testing

Halvard Systems has ten business days to test each deliverable. A deliverable is accepted if Halvard Systems raises no written defect within that window.

## Fees and Adjustments

Fees are fixed for the initial term. Calderwood Data Services may propose an adjustment of no more than three percent for a renewal term, with ninety days written notice.

## Taxes

Fees are exclusive of applicable sales and value-added taxes, which Halvard Systems pays where properly charged by Calderwood Data Services.

## Expenses

Calderwood Data Services may recharge pre-approved travel expenses at cost. Expenses without written pre-approval from Halvard Systems are not payable.

## Invoicing Disputes

Halvard Systems shall raise an invoice dispute within twenty business days of receipt. The undisputed portion of an invoice remains payable.

## Records and Audit

Calderwood Data Services shall keep records supporting its charges for three years and make them available to Halvard Systems once per year on thirty days notice.

## Security Standards

Calderwood Data Services shall maintain an information security programme with annual penetration testing, documented patching, and least-privilege access control.

## Business Continuity

Calderwood Data Services shall maintain a business continuity plan, test it annually, and share the test summary with Halvard Systems on request.

## Disaster Recovery

Calderwood Data Services shall maintain a recovery time objective of four hours and a recovery point objective of fifteen minutes for the production environment used by Halvard Systems.

## Subcontractors

Calderwood Data Services remains responsible for the acts of its subcontractors and shall not subcontract a material part of the services without written consent.

## Personnel

Calderwood Data Services shall assign suitably qualified personnel and shall replace any individual whose performance Halvard Systems reasonably objects to in writing.

## Training

Calderwood Data Services shall deliver two administrator training sessions per contract year at no additional charge to Halvard Systems.

## Documentation

Calderwood Data Services shall keep user and operations documentation current and make it available to Halvard Systems in an electronic format.

## Intellectual Property

Each party retains its pre-existing intellectual property. Deliverables created specifically for Halvard Systems are assigned to Halvard Systems on payment.

## License Grant

Calderwood Data Services grants Halvard Systems a non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the platform for internal business purposes during the term.

## Feedback

Calderwood Data Services may use feedback from Halvard Systems to improve its services, provided the feedback is anonymised and identifies no Customer Data.

## Open Source Components

Calderwood Data Services shall list open source components used in the services and shall not introduce a component whose licence would affect the rights of Halvard Systems.

## Publicity

Neither Calderwood Data Services nor Halvard Systems may use the name or marks of the other in publicity without prior written consent.

## Non-Solicitation

During the term and for six months afterwards, neither party may solicit an employee of the other who was directly involved in the services.

## Compliance with Laws

Calderwood Data Services shall comply with the laws applicable to its performance and shall hold the permits required to deliver the services to Halvard Systems.

## Anti-Bribery

Calderwood Data Services shall maintain an anti-bribery policy and shall not offer anything of value to influence a decision of Halvard Systems.

## Conflicts of Interest

Calderwood Data Services shall declare any relationship that could create a conflict of interest with the review or approval process of Halvard Systems.

## Regulatory Cooperation

Calderwood Data Services shall cooperate with a regulator request that concerns the services and shall tell Halvard Systems unless prohibited from doing so.

## Assignment

Neither party may assign this agreement without consent, except to a successor of substantially all of its business.

## Force Majeure

Neither Halvard Systems nor Calderwood Data Services is liable for a failure caused by an event beyond its reasonable control, provided it mitigates the effect promptly.

## Severability

If a provision is held unenforceable, the remainder of this agreement continues in force and the provision is read down to the minimum extent needed.

## Entire Agreement

This agreement and its schedules are the entire agreement between Halvard Systems and Calderwood Data Services on their subject matter.

## Amendments

An amendment is effective only if it is in writing and signed by an authorised representative of each party.

## Waiver

A failure to enforce a right is not a waiver of that right, and a single waiver does not waive any later breach.

## Survival

Clauses on confidentiality, liability, governing law, and payment of accrued fees survive termination of this agreement.

## Counterparts

This agreement may be signed in counterparts, and an electronic signature has the same effect as an original.

## Interpretation

Headings are for convenience only. References to days are calendar days unless the clause says business days.

## Schedule A - Service Catalog

The catalogue lists the environments, data feeds, and reporting packs Calderwood Data Services provides to Halvard Systems under this agreement.

## Schedule B - Fee Table

The fee table sets a platform fee per environment, a usage fee per million events, and a fixed onboarding fee.

## Schedule C - Support Hours

Standard support hours for Calderwood Data Services are 08:00 to 18:00 local time on business days. Out-of-hours support is available for priority-one incidents only.

## Signatures

Signed for Halvard Systems by Marit Halvorsen, Director of Procurement. Signed for Calderwood Data Services by Nils Ekstrand, Managing Director. All signatories named in this document are fictional and no real person is represented.
